title: Collab P0: @flash/collab Yjs binding (FlashDocument<->Y.Doc), property-tested, no networking
description: Foundation (THE BET) for optional P2P multiplayer. Approved: derived-binding (option b) — immutable FlashDocument stays source of truth; Yjs does the merge; the binding is a faithful projection. NEW package packages/collab (@flash/collab) so Yjs stays OUT of @flash/core (which must stay pure Node/browser/Tauri). Implement: (1) Full FlashDocument<->Y.Doc type mapping per the plan: root Y.Map; scenes/layers/frames as Y.Array (frames positional, no id); frame.displayObjects as Y.Map keyed by DisplayObject.id; displayObject SCALARS (x,y,scale,rotation,alpha,filters,...) as per-field Y.Map entries (per-field merge); displayObject.shape GEOMETRY as an ATOMIC plain-JSON value (segments have no stable id; whole-shape last-writer-wins — finer would require forbidden custom merge); library.items as Y.Map keyed by id; symbol.timeline nested like scene timeline; asClasses as Y.Map<path, Y.Text> (character-level); properties/classpaths/publishProfiles as Y.Map/Y.Array; bitmap/sound/video dataUri NOT in Y (store assetId+hash; bytes out-of-band in P4). (2) OUTBOUND: hook documentStore pushDoc (the single chokepoint, store/documentStore.ts) — diff the new FlashDocument vs last-synced using the model's structural-sharing reference equality (descend only where refs differ), apply the delta in one Y.transact with a localOrigin. (3) INBOUND: observe the Y.Doc with origin-filtering (ignore localOrigin); on remote update rebuild the affected subtree and call replaceDoc (NOT pushDoc — remote edits must not create local undo entries). (4) Behind an opt-in flag; default OFF; NO networking yet (wire two in-process Y.Docs in tests). Solo app behaves identically with flag off. ACCEPTANCE (gate everything on this): a PROPERTY TEST — generate random mutation sequences through the REAL packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts pure functions, sync source doc via the binding to a second Y.Doc, rebuild a FlashDocument from it, assert deepEqual to source; cover add/remove/move/update across scenes/layers/frames/displayObjects/library/asClasses/properties + symbol timelines. Also audit that NO mutation path bypasses pushDoc/replaceDoc/commitDrag (if any do, list them). VERIFY: build + all tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable); solo unchanged; property test rock-solid. Create docs/37-collab.md (architecture + the mapping + decisions + honest tradeoffs). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's). Scope: new packages/collab + documentStore hook + flag + property tests + docs. Do NOT under-scope the binding fidelity — it's the whole risk.
